hero.title: About NAM DU MACHINE
hero.subtitle: A Vietnamese supplier of turnkey cashew processing plants, built on years of working side by side with cashew factories.

story.title: Our story
paragraphs: NAM DU MACHINE was built by a team that spent years building and repairing cashew machines for local factories. Listening to operators every day taught us exactly where machines fail and what factories really need.

Today we specialise in turnkey projects: fully automatic cashew processing plants with a capacity of 10 to 100 tonnes a day. Each plant covers every stage, from raw nut grading, steaming, and shelling to drying, humidifying, peeling, kernel grading, and packing, and we handle the layout, machines, installation, and commissioning.

Africa is our main market. We supply technology and machines to countries such as Côte d'Ivoire, Nigeria, Ghana, and Tanzania, helping them move from exporting raw nuts to processing them locally, so more of the value, jobs, and skills stay in the country.
We have since expanded into South Asia, including India and Pakistan, and across Southeast Asia.

mission: Help cashew-growing countries turn raw nuts into finished kernels at home, with reliable turnkey plants and long-term support.
vision: Be the trusted turnkey partner for cashew processing across Africa and Asia.
